bounded live BioContainers lookup. Use a bare tagged reference without

  set -eu
  selected-command \
    --input "$(inputs.input.path)" \
    --output result.tsv

inputs:
  - name: input
    type: data
    format: [tabular]

outputs:

    format: tabular

import pathlib
import sys
import zipfile
archive = sys.argv[1]
member = '996662at2759.faa.mafft.clipkit.treefile'
with zipfile.ZipFile(archive) as zf:
    matches = [name for name in zf.namelist() if name == member]
    if len(matches) != 1:
        raise SystemExit(f'expected exactly one {member}, found {len(matches)}')
    pathlib.Path('tree.nwk').write_bytes(zf.read(member))
pathlib.Path('selected_member.txt').write_text(member + '\n')
PY

python - <<'PY'
import pathlib
import re
import statistics
member = '996662at2759.faa.mafft.clipkit.treefile'
values = []
for line in pathlib.Path('phykit_scores.tsv').read_text().splitlines():
    if not line.strip() or line.lstrip().startswith('#'):
        continue
    fields = re.split(r'[\t ]+', line.strip())
    for field in reversed(fields):
        try:
            values.append(float(field))
            break
        except ValueError:
            pass
if not values:
    raise SystemExit('no numeric long branch scores parsed from PhyKIT verbose output')
median = statistics.median(values)
with open('result.tsv', 'w') as out:
    out.write('field\tvalue\n')
    out.write(f'selected_member\t{member}\n')
    out.write(f'score_count\t{len(values)}\n')
    out.write(f'median\t{median:.17g}\n')
PY

import pathlib
import sys
import zipfile
archive = sys.argv[1]
member = '996662at2759.faa.mafft.clipkit.treefile'
with zipfile.ZipFile(archive) as zf:
    matches = [name for name in zf.namelist() if name == member]
    if len(matches) != 1:
        raise SystemExit(f'expected exactly one {member}, found {len(matches)}')
    pathlib.Path('tree.nwk').write_bytes(zf.read(member))
pathlib.Path('selected_member.txt').write_text(member + '\n')
PY
phykit long_branch_score tree.nwk > phykit_summary.txt
phykit long_branch_score tree.nwk --verbose > phykit_scores.tsv
python - <<'PY'
import pathlib
import re
import statistics
member = '996662at2759.faa.mafft.clipkit.treefile'
values = []
for line in pathlib.Path('phykit_scores.tsv').read_text().splitlines():
    if not line.strip() or line.lstrip().startswith('#'):
        continue
    fields = re.split(r'[\t ]+', line.strip())
    for field in reversed(fields):
        try:
            values.append(float(field))
            break
        except ValueError:
            pass
if not values:
    raise SystemExit('no numeric long branch scores parsed from PhyKIT verbose output')
median = statistics.median(values)
with open('result.tsv', 'w') as out:
    out.write('field\tvalue\n')
    out.write(f'selected_member\t{member}\n')
    out.write(f'score_count\t{len(values)}\n')
    out.write(f'median\t{median:.17g}\n')
PY
cat phykit_summary.txt > summary.txt
cat phykit_scores.tsv > scores.tsv
